intro.text: Legendary people of Canticle who could survive its sun, taking the sun's power into themselves instead of being destroyed by it.

description.text: Their gift let them stay in one place long enough to build an underground city, the Refuge of Stone, and they had some way to keep stone from melting.

items.text: The Beaconites proclaimed Nomad a Sunlit Man after he returned speaking their language.
Nomad told Rebeke that he disliked being called Sunlit.
The Greater Good recognized Rebeke Salvage as the Sunlit One.
